title: Tesla Optimus robot is now doing real factory work

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Look at this — a robot building cars in a Tesla factory, right now.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This isn’t a prototype — it’s real, working on the production line.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The Optimus robot is now doing heavy lifting and welding tasks.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: It uses advanced sensors and AI to navigate and perform precise movements.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This changes how factories operate — faster, safer, and with less human risk.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The future of manufacturing is here, and it’s powered by AI and robotics.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Have you seen what Optimus can do? Let me know in the comments.

caption_text: Tesla Optimus robot is now doing real factory work
